response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced senior IC (14+ years) with genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), taught Selenium/TDD courses, and managed CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure at Altom. However, the role is a people-management position (Level II Manager) requiring 2+ years of formal people management and 3+ years of technical leadership, and the resume shows no evidence of managing engineers, running one-on-ones, owning performance reviews, or leading organizational change. Titles are consistently IC (Senior/Staff Software Developer), and mobile-platform exposure is limited to a brief iOS/Apple TV stint in 2015-16. He would be a strong senior/staff IC candidate for a developer-productivity team, but is not a fit as-written for the manager opening.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tools background: built test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD and build infrastructure
14+ years of broad software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, courses, and conference talks — a good managerial foundation
concerns: No demonstrated people-management experience — no direct reports, one-on-ones, or performance ownership
No evidence of formal technical leadership scope (roadmaps, cross-team alignment, org change)
Minimal mobile-platform ecosystem depth; iOS work was a one-off nearly a decade ago

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure expertise
No technical leadership or roadmap ownership evidence
